reservation_tables.provider:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS open_provider_resources(
        lease_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,allocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        digest TEXT NOT NULL,intent BLOB NOT NULL,record BLOB NOT NULL,root_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
        purpose TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,status_record BLOB NOT NULL,
        generation INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,retain_until INTEGER NOT NULL,
        requests_used INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,allocation_id))
reservation_tables.contact:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS open_contact_resource_leases(
        lease_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,allocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        allocation_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,purpose TEXT NOT NULL,record BLOB NOT NULL,
        max_items INTEGER NOT NULL,max_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        retain_until INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,grant_request TEXT,
        UNIQUE(owner,allocation_id))

capacity_tables:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS open_capacity_policy(
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
        maximum_reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,maximum_reservations INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS open_capacity_reservations(
        service TEXT NOT NULL,reservation_id TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT NOT NULL,
        charge_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,retain_until INTEGER NOT NULL,
        owner TEXT NOT NULL,operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,root_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(service,reservation_id))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS open_capacity_retention ON open_capacity_reservations(service,retain_until)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS open_capacity_provider_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON open_provider_resources WHEN NEW.lease_id IS NOT OLD.lease_id OR NEW.owner IS NOT OLD.owner OR NEW.allocation_id IS NOT OLD.allocation_id OR NEW.digest IS NOT OLD.digest OR NEW.intent IS NOT OLD.intent OR NEW.record IS NOT OLD.record OR NEW.root_digest IS NOT OLD.root_digest OR NEW.purpose IS NOT OLD.purpose OR NEW.generation IS NOT OLD.generation OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.retain_until IS NOT OLD.retain_until BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'open_capacity_immutable_reservation'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS open_capacity_contact_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON open_contact_resource_leases WHEN NEW.lease_id IS NOT OLD.lease_id OR NEW.owner IS NOT OLD.owner OR NEW.allocation_id IS NOT OLD.allocation_id OR NEW.allocation_sha256 IS NOT OLD.allocation_sha256 OR NEW.purpose IS NOT OLD.purpose OR NEW.record IS NOT OLD.record OR NEW.max_items IS NOT OLD.max_items OR NEW.max_bytes IS NOT OLD.max_bytes OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.retain_until IS NOT OLD.retain_until BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'open_capacity_immutable_reservation'); END
